findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_ai_governance_framework" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.php" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_ai_governance_profile · Private data: submit_ai_governance_profile, get_ai_governance_framework · Public sink: submit_ai_governance_profile, get_ai_governance_framework.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_ai_governance_profile · Private data: submit_ai_governance_profile, get_ai_governance_framework · Public sink: submit_ai_governance_profile, get_ai_governance_framework

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
